_comment: The Plan Your Event estimator. Prices here are the SAME numbers as the packages in private-events.json — that file is the customer-facing menu, this one drives the maths. Keep them in step; the build fails if a package name here has no match there.

intro.heading: Build your estimate
intro.lead: Four short steps and you will have a price to work from. Nothing is booked and no card is needed — a real person reviews every estimate before anything is confirmed.

guests._comment: Floor for most events. An event type may set its own minGuests — a clinic runs with far fewer people than a buyout — and the estimator raises the count if you switch to a type that needs more.

_pricing_comment: guests x (food pp + beverage pp), then service on top. Verified against the original: 20 x ($30 + $25) = $1,100, +20% = $1,320. Add-ons carry no price — they are quoted, so the estimate stays honest rather than pretending to be a quote.
addonsNote: Add-ons are priced on inquiry and are not included in the figure above.
customMenuNote: Our events team can curate dietary-specific or themed catering on request — mention it in the notes.
estimateDisclaimer: A preliminary estimate based on your selections. Final pricing depends on your catering choices and the date.
